biotools.summary: paraCell is a software tool that allows users to visualize and analyze pre-loaded single-cell data without requiring programming ability, built as an expansion of cellxgene_VIP. It provides tools for interactive analysis and visualization of standard and dual host–parasite single-cell RNA-seq data.
